final_trustworthiness_assessment: High for primary sources. healthunit.com (Middlesex-London Health Unit) is the primary reporting authority and is the most authoritative source for this outbreak. publichealthontario.ca is the provincial surveillance authority. lhsc.on.ca (London Health Sciences Centre) is a credible hospital system source. cbc.ca and ctvnews.ca are established Canadian national/regional broadcasters. crisis24.com is a credible risk intelligence service that cites MLHU as its primary source. beaconbio.org is a disease surveillance aggregator that cites named sources and dates — acceptable as a secondary corroborating source. The beaconbio Toronto 2026 result (out of scope) must be excluded. YouTube clips are lower-trust for structured data but confirm outbreak re-declaration timeline. Reddit, Facebook, and LinkedIn results should be excluded from data extraction.
